versions.changelog:
- Switched to using example template files for initial skill setup: now copies from `.example` files on first run for preferences, proxy, tracking, and history.
- Removed default configuration/data files from the repository; only example template files are now shipped.
- Documentation updated to reflect the change in initialization workflow. 
- No workflow or user-facing logic changes beyond the file initialization mechanism.

- Major internal refactor to modularize skill logic into sub-skills.
- Added comprehensive documentation files: AGENTS.md, download.md, feedback.md, history.md, preferences.md, proxy.md, search.md, and tracking/history.md.
- Introduced preferences.json and tracking/downloads.json for persistent configuration and download tracking.
- Clarified and expanded workflow and intervention logic in documentation.
- Enhanced maintainability by structuring all core features into separate, clearly described modules.
